value.rationale: This is not a new volume theorem: Heuer–Striker Theorem 3.8 gives the all-n volume. The supported value is the closed finite factorial expression for every interior uniform mixed polynomial moment, plus the strict geometry-to-combinatorics theorem: two different entries have negative covariance if and only if their rook positions attack and positive covariance otherwise. It supplies exact integration and a natural statistical encoding of row/column conflicts beyond the scalar known volume; all dimensions n>=2 are covered analytically.
